title: First-Order Passive Membrane RC Decay
description: Passive cellular membrane equivalent RC circuit modeling exponential voltage relaxation toward resting potential via a linear Ohmic leak conductance in CellML 1.1.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<model name="passive_rc_membrane" xmlns="http://www.cellml.org/cellml/1.1#">
  <units name="millisecond">
    <unit units="second" prefix="milli"/>
  </units>
  <units name="millivolt">
    <unit units="volt" prefix="milli"/>
  </units>
  <units name="microfarad_per_cmsq">
    <unit units="farad" prefix="micro"/>
    <unit units="metre" prefix="centi" exponent="-2"/>
  </units>
  <units name="millisiemens_per_cmsq">
    <unit units="siemens" prefix="milli"/>
    <unit units="metre" prefix="centi" exponent="-2"/>
  </units>
  <units name="microampere_per_cmsq">
    <unit units="ampere" prefix="micro"/>
    <unit units="metre" prefix="centi" exponent="-2"/>
  </units>

  <component name="environment">
    <variable name="time" units="millisecond" public_interface="out"/>
  </component>

  <component name="membrane">
    <variable name="time" units="millisecond" public_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="V" units="millivolt" initial_value="-40.0" public_interface="out"/>
    <variable name="Cm" units="microfarad_per_cmsq" initial_value="1.0"/>
    <variable name="g_L" units="millisiemens_per_cmsq" initial_value="0.3"/>
    <variable name="E_L" units="millivolt" initial_value="-70.0"/>
    <variable name="i_L" units="microampere_per_cmsq"/>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>i_L</ci>
        <apply>
          <times/>
          <ci>g_L</ci>
          <apply><minus/><ci>V</ci><ci>E_L</ci></apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <apply>
          <diff/>
          <bvar><ci>time</ci></bvar>
          <ci>V</ci>
        </apply>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <apply><minus/><ci>i_L</ci></apply>
          <ci>Cm</ci>
        </apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
  </component>

  <connection>
    <map_components component_1="environment" component_2="membrane"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="time" variable_2="time"/>
  </connection>
</model>

title: Hodgkin-Huxley 1952 Squid Giant Axon Action Potential
description: Classic 4-state Hodgkin-Huxley neuronal excitability model with voltage-gated sodium (m, h), potassium (n), and leak ion channels encapsulated beneath the membrane component.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<model name="hodgkin_huxley_1952" xmlns="http://www.cellml.org/cellml/1.1#">
  <units name="millisecond">
    <unit units="second" prefix="milli"/>
  </units>
  <units name="per_millisecond">
    <unit units="second" prefix="milli" exponent="-1"/>
  </units>
  <units name="millivolt">
    <unit units="volt" prefix="milli"/>
  </units>
  <units name="microfarad_per_cmsq">
    <unit units="farad" prefix="micro"/>
    <unit units="metre" prefix="centi" exponent="-2"/>
  </units>
  <units name="millisiemens_per_cmsq">
    <unit units="siemens" prefix="milli"/>
    <unit units="metre" prefix="centi" exponent="-2"/>
  </units>
  <units name="microampere_per_cmsq">
    <unit units="ampere" prefix="micro"/>
    <unit units="metre" prefix="centi" exponent="-2"/>
  </units>

  <component name="environment">
    <variable name="time" units="millisecond" public_interface="out"/>
  </component>

  <component name="membrane">
    <variable name="time" units="millisecond" public_interface="in" private_interface="out"/>
    <variable name="V" units="millivolt" initial_value="-65.0" public_interface="out" private_interface="out"/>
    <variable name="Cm" units="microfarad_per_cmsq" initial_value="1.0"/>
    <variable name="i_Stim" units="microampere_per_cmsq"/>
    <variable name="i_Na" units="microampere_per_cmsq" private_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="i_K" units="microampere_per_cmsq" private_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="i_L" units="microampere_per_cmsq" private_interface="in"/>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>i_Stim</ci>
        <piecewise>
          <piece>
            <cn>-20.0</cn>
            <apply>
              <and/>
              <apply><geq/><ci>time</ci><cn>2.0</cn></apply>
              <apply><leq/><ci>time</ci><cn>2.5</cn></apply>
            </apply>
          </piece>
          <otherwise>
            <cn>0.0</cn>
          </otherwise>
        </piecewise>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <apply>
          <diff/>
          <bvar><ci>time</ci></bvar>
          <ci>V</ci>
        </apply>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <apply>
            <minus/>
            <apply><plus/><ci>i_Stim</ci><ci>i_Na</ci><ci>i_K</ci><ci>i_L</ci></apply>
          </apply>
          <ci>Cm</ci>
        </apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
  </component>

  <component name="sodium_channel">
    <variable name="time" units="millisecond" public_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="V" units="millivolt" public_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="g_Na" units="millisiemens_per_cmsq" initial_value="120.0"/>
    <variable name="E_Na" units="millivolt" initial_value="50.0"/>
    <variable name="m" units="dimensionless" initial_value="0.0529"/>
    <variable name="h" units="dimensionless" initial_value="0.5961"/>
    <variable name="alpha_m" units="per_millisecond"/>
    <variable name="beta_m" units="per_millisecond"/>
    <variable name="alpha_h" units="per_millisecond"/>
    <variable name="beta_h" units="per_millisecond"/>
    <variable name="i_Na" units="microampere_per_cmsq" public_interface="out"/>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>alpha_m</ci>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <apply><times/><cn>0.1</cn><apply><plus/><ci>V</ci><cn>40.0</cn></apply></apply>
          <apply><minus/><cn>1.0</cn><apply><exp/><apply><divide/><apply><minus/><apply><plus/><ci>V</ci><cn>40.0</cn></apply></apply><cn>10.0</cn></apply></apply></apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>beta_m</ci>
        <apply><times/><cn>4.0</cn><apply><exp/><apply><divide/><apply><minus/><apply><plus/><ci>V</ci><cn>65.0</cn></apply></apply><cn>18.0</cn></apply></apply></apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>alpha_h</ci>
        <apply><times/><cn>0.07</cn><apply><exp/><apply><divide/><apply><minus/><apply><plus/><ci>V</ci><cn>65.0</cn></apply></apply><cn>20.0</cn></apply></apply></apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>beta_h</ci>
        <apply><divide/><cn>1.0</cn><apply><plus/><cn>1.0</cn><apply><exp/><apply><divide/><apply><minus/><apply><plus/><ci>V</ci><cn>35.0</cn></apply></apply><cn>10.0</cn></apply></apply></apply></apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <apply><diff/><bvar><ci>time</ci></bvar><ci>m</ci></apply>
        <apply><minus/><apply><times/><ci>alpha_m</ci><apply><minus/><cn>1.0</cn><ci>m</ci></apply></apply><apply><times/><ci>beta_m</ci><ci>m</ci></apply></apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <apply><diff/><bvar><ci>time</ci></bvar><ci>h</ci></apply>
        <apply><minus/><apply><times/><ci>alpha_h</ci><apply><minus/><cn>1.0</cn><ci>h</ci></apply></apply><apply><times/><ci>beta_h</ci><ci>h</ci></apply></apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>i_Na</ci>
        <apply><times/><ci>g_Na</ci><apply><power/><ci>m</ci><cn>3</cn></apply><ci>h</ci><apply><minus/><ci>V</ci><ci>E_Na</ci></apply></apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
  </component>

  <component name="potassium_channel">
    <variable name="time" units="millisecond" public_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="V" units="millivolt" public_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="g_K" units="millisiemens_per_cmsq" initial_value="36.0"/>
    <variable name="E_K" units="millivolt" initial_value="-77.0"/>
    <variable name="n" units="dimensionless" initial_value="0.3177"/>
    <variable name="alpha_n" units="per_millisecond"/>
    <variable name="beta_n" units="per_millisecond"/>
    <variable name="i_K" units="microampere_per_cmsq" public_interface="out"/>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>alpha_n</ci>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <apply><times/><cn>0.01</cn><apply><plus/><ci>V</ci><cn>55.0</cn></apply></apply>
          <apply><minus/><cn>1.0</cn><apply><exp/><apply><divide/><apply><minus/><apply><plus/><ci>V</ci><cn>55.0</cn></apply></apply><cn>10.0</cn></apply></apply></apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>beta_n</ci>
        <apply><times/><cn>0.125</cn><apply><exp/><apply><divide/><apply><minus/><apply><plus/><ci>V</ci><cn>65.0</cn></apply></apply><cn>80.0</cn></apply></apply></apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <apply><diff/><bvar><ci>time</ci></bvar><ci>n</ci></apply>
        <apply><minus/><apply><times/><ci>alpha_n</ci><apply><minus/><cn>1.0</cn><ci>n</ci></apply></apply><apply><times/><ci>beta_n</ci><ci>n</ci></apply></apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>i_K</ci>
        <apply><times/><ci>g_K</ci><apply><power/><ci>n</ci><cn>4</cn></apply><apply><minus/><ci>V</ci><ci>E_K</ci></apply></apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
  </component>

  <component name="leakage_current">
    <variable name="V" units="millivolt" public_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="g_L" units="millisiemens_per_cmsq" initial_value="0.3"/>
    <variable name="E_L" units="millivolt" initial_value="-54.387"/>
    <variable name="i_L" units="microampere_per_cmsq" public_interface="out"/>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>i_L</ci>
        <apply><times/><ci>g_L</ci><apply><minus/><ci>V</ci><ci>E_L</ci></apply></apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
  </component>

  <group>
    <relationship_ref relationship="encapsulation"/>
    <component_ref component="membrane">
      <component_ref component="sodium_channel"/>
      <component_ref component="potassium_channel"/>
      <component_ref component="leakage_current"/>
    </component_ref>
  </group>

  <connection>
    <map_components component_1="environment" component_2="membrane"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="time" variable_2="time"/>
  </connection>
  <connection>
    <map_components component_1="environment" component_2="sodium_channel"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="time" variable_2="time"/>
  </connection>
  <connection>
    <map_components component_1="environment" component_2="potassium_channel"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="time" variable_2="time"/>
  </connection>
  <connection>
    <map_components component_1="membrane" component_2="sodium_channel"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="V" variable_2="V"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="i_Na" variable_2="i_Na"/>
  </connection>
  <connection>
    <map_components component_1="membrane" component_2="potassium_channel"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="V" variable_2="V"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="i_K" variable_2="i_K"/>
  </connection>
  <connection>
    <map_components component_1="membrane" component_2="leakage_current"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="V" variable_2="V"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="i_L" variable_2="i_L"/>
  </connection>
</model>

title: FitzHugh-Nagumo Excitable Cardiac Cell Oscillator
description: Two-variable reduced-order FitzHugh-Nagumo cardiac excitable cell dynamics coupling fast membrane excitation (v) with slow recovery (w) and periodic external pacing stimulus.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<model name="fitzhugh_nagumo_cardiac" xmlns="http://www.cellml.org/cellml/1.1#">
  <units name="millisecond">
    <unit units="second" prefix="milli"/>
  </units>
  <units name="per_millisecond">
    <unit units="second" prefix="milli" exponent="-1"/>
  </units>

  <component name="environment">
    <variable name="time" units="millisecond" public_interface="out"/>
  </component>

  <component name="stimulus">
    <variable name="time" units="millisecond" public_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="I_ext" units="per_millisecond" public_interface="out"/>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>I_ext</ci>
        <piecewise>
          <piece>
            <cn>0.5</cn>
            <apply>
              <and/>
              <apply><geq/><ci>time</ci><cn>5.0</cn></apply>
              <apply><leq/><ci>time</ci><cn>15.0</cn></apply>
            </apply>
          </piece>
          <otherwise>
            <cn>0.0</cn>
          </otherwise>
        </piecewise>
      </apply>
    </math>
  </component>

  <component name="cardiac_cell">
    <variable name="time" units="millisecond" public_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="I_ext" units="per_millisecond" public_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="v" units="dimensionless" initial_value="0.0" public_interface="out"/>
    <variable name="w" units="dimensionless" initial_value="0.0" public_interface="out"/>
    <variable name="a" units="dimensionless" initial_value="0.13"/>
    <variable name="b" units="dimensionless" initial_value="0.013"/>
    <variable name="c1" units="per_millisecond" initial_value="0.26"/>
    <variable name="c2" units="per_millisecond" initial_value="0.10"/>
    <variable name="d" units="dimensionless" initial_value="1.0"/>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <apply><diff/><bvar><ci>time</ci></bvar><ci>v</ci></apply>
        <apply>
          <plus/>
          <apply>
            <minus/>
            <apply>
              <times/>
              <ci>c1</ci>
              <ci>v</ci>
              <apply><minus/><ci>v</ci><ci>a</ci></apply>
              <apply><minus/><cn>1.0</cn><ci>v</ci></apply>
            </apply>
            <apply><times/><ci>c2</ci><ci>v</ci><ci>w</ci></apply>
          </apply>
          <ci>I_ext</ci>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <apply><diff/><bvar><ci>time</ci></bvar><ci>w</ci></apply>
        <apply>
          <times/>
          <ci>b</ci>
          <apply><minus/><ci>v</ci><apply><times/><ci>d</ci><ci>w</ci></apply></apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
  </component>

  <connection>
    <map_components component_1="environment" component_2="stimulus"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="time" variable_2="time"/>
  </connection>
  <connection>
    <map_components component_1="environment" component_2="cardiac_cell"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="time" variable_2="time"/>
  </connection>
  <connection>
    <map_components component_1="stimulus" component_2="cardiac_cell"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="I_ext" variable_2="I_ext"/>
  </connection>
</model>

title: Modular Ventricular Myocyte Importing Ion Channels
description: CellML 1.1 modular cardiac ventricular myocyte importing reusable fast sodium and delayed-rectifier potassium ion channel sub-models via xlink:href.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<model name="ventricular_myocyte_modular" xmlns="http://www.cellml.org/cellml/1.1#" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <import xlink:href="sodium_channel.cellml">
    <component name="sodium_channel_imp" component_ref="sodium_channel"/>
  </import>
  <import xlink:href="potassium_channel.cellml">
    <component name="potassium_channel_imp" component_ref="potassium_channel"/>
  </import>

  <units name="millisecond">
    <unit units="second" prefix="milli"/>
  </units>
  <units name="millivolt">
    <unit units="volt" prefix="milli"/>
  </units>
  <units name="microfarad_per_cmsq">
    <unit units="farad" prefix="micro"/>
    <unit units="metre" prefix="centi" exponent="-2"/>
  </units>
  <units name="millisiemens_per_cmsq">
    <unit units="siemens" prefix="milli"/>
    <unit units="metre" prefix="centi" exponent="-2"/>
  </units>
  <units name="microampere_per_cmsq">
    <unit units="ampere" prefix="micro"/>
    <unit units="metre" prefix="centi" exponent="-2"/>
  </units>

  <component name="environment">
    <variable name="time" units="millisecond" public_interface="out"/>
  </component>

  <component name="membrane">
    <variable name="time" units="millisecond" public_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="V" units="millivolt" initial_value="-85.0" public_interface="out"/>
    <variable name="Cm" units="microfarad_per_cmsq" initial_value="1.0"/>
    <variable name="g_b" units="millisiemens_per_cmsq" initial_value="0.039"/>
    <variable name="E_b" units="millivolt" initial_value="-60.0"/>
    <variable name="i_b" units="microampere_per_cmsq"/>
    <variable name="i_Stim" units="microampere_per_cmsq"/>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>i_Stim</ci>
        <piecewise>
          <piece>
            <cn>-40.0</cn>
            <apply>
              <and/>
              <apply><geq/><ci>time</ci><cn>10.0</cn></apply>
              <apply><leq/><ci>time</ci><cn>11.0</cn></apply>
            </apply>
          </piece>
          <otherwise>
            <cn>0.0</cn>
          </otherwise>
        </piecewise>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>i_b</ci>
        <apply><times/><ci>g_b</ci><apply><minus/><ci>V</ci><ci>E_b</ci></apply></apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <apply><diff/><bvar><ci>time</ci></bvar><ci>V</ci></apply>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <apply><minus/><apply><plus/><ci>i_Stim</ci><ci>i_b</ci></apply></apply>
          <ci>Cm</ci>
        </apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
  </component>

  <connection>
    <map_components component_1="environment" component_2="membrane"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="time" variable_2="time"/>
  </connection>
</model>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<model name="cardiac_potassium_channel_module" xmlns="http://www.cellml.org/cellml/1.1#">
  <units name="millisecond">
    <unit units="second" prefix="milli"/>
  </units>
  <units name="per_millisecond">
    <unit units="second" prefix="milli" exponent="-1"/>
  </units>
  <units name="millivolt">
    <unit units="volt" prefix="milli"/>
  </units>
  <units name="millisiemens_per_cmsq">
    <unit units="siemens" prefix="milli"/>
    <unit units="metre" prefix="centi" exponent="-2"/>
  </units>
  <units name="microampere_per_cmsq">
    <unit units="ampere" prefix="micro"/>
    <unit units="metre" prefix="centi" exponent="-2"/>
  </units>

  <component name="potassium_channel">
    <variable name="time" units="millisecond" public_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="V" units="millivolt" public_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="g_K" units="millisiemens_per_cmsq" initial_value="0.282"/>
    <variable name="E_K" units="millivolt" initial_value="-77.0"/>
    <variable name="x_k" units="dimensionless" initial_value="0.0057"/>
    <variable name="alpha_x" units="per_millisecond"/>
    <variable name="beta_x" units="per_millisecond"/>
    <variable name="i_K" units="microampere_per_cmsq" public_interface="out"/>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
      <apply>
